pendentes.alt: Sala clara com janelas abertas em paredes opostas, cortinas leves de linho balançando com a brisa e plantas no canto
pendentes.pedido: A bright, airy living room with tall open windows on two opposite walls, sheer white linen curtains gently lifted by a breeze. Light oak floor, a low beige sofa, a woven jute rug and a large potted plant near the window. Soft morning daylight, green garden visible through both windows. Interior design photography, wide angle, eye level.

pendentes.alt: Parede de sala em tom quente com uma pintura abstrata emoldurada, iluminada de forma suave por um spot no teto
pendentes.pedido: A calm living room wall painted in warm off-white with a single large abstract painting in muted ochre and blue tones, framed in thin natural oak. A discreet ceiling track spotlight casts a soft, even wash of warm light over the canvas. Below it, a low walnut sideboard with a ceramic vase. Evening ambience, interior design photography, eye level.

pendentes.alt: Casa térrea recém-construída com fachada clara, jardim recém-plantado e caminho de pedra até a porta de entrada
pendentes.pedido: A newly completed single-story contemporary house with a light plaster facade, large glass sliding doors and a flat roof with a thin concrete overhang. Freshly planted lawn, young shrubs and a stone path leading to a wooden front door. Clean site with no construction debris, clear blue sky, soft late-morning sunlight. Architectural photography, three-quarter view, eye level.

pendentes.alt: Canto de sala com luz suave e indireta, vasos de cerâmica com zamioculca, espada-de-são-jorge e jiboia pendente sobre um aparador de madeira
pendentes.pedido: A calm corner of a living room lit only by soft indirect daylight from a side window out of frame. Matte ceramic pots in earthy tones hold a ZZ plant, a tall snake plant and a trailing pothos cascading from a light oak sideboard. Linen curtain, warm white walls, wooden floor. Interior design photography, eye level, gentle shadows.

pendentes.alt: Sala de jantar clara com mesa oval de madeira, seis cadeiras estofadas e espaço livre de circulação até o aparador
pendentes.pedido: A bright dining room with an oval solid wood dining table and six upholstered chairs, generous free space around it leading to a low wooden sideboard against a pale wall. A simple linen table runner and a ceramic bowl on the table, a large window with sheer curtains. Interior design photography, wide angle, soft natural daylight.

pendentes.alt: Telhado cerâmico de uma casa térrea com fileiras de painéis solares sob céu azul e jardim arborizado ao redor
pendentes.pedido: A single-story contemporary house with a terracotta clay tile roof covered by neat rows of dark blue solar panels, under a clear blue sky. Lush tropical garden with a few palm trees and a lawn in front, white plastered walls and large glass doors. Architectural photography from a slightly elevated angle, bright late-morning sunlight, crisp shadows.

pendentes.alt: Mesa de madeira clara com uma pasta de documentos fechada, uma calculadora e um molho de chaves ao lado de uma janela com luz da manhã
pendentes.pedido: A light oak desk beside a large window in a calm modern apartment. On the desk, a closed plain beige document folder, a simple gray calculator and a small set of house keys on a leather keyring. Soft morning sunlight, a green plant in a ceramic pot in the background, shallow depth of field, editorial interior photography.

pendentes.alt: Sala de estar clara com cortinas longas de linho cru do teto ao piso e uma persiana rolô branca parcialmente baixada na janela
pendentes.pedido: A bright contemporary living room with a tall window dressed in two layers: a white roller shade half lowered and long natural linen curtains hanging from a ceiling track down to the wooden floor. A light gray sofa, a jute rug and a small side table with a ceramic vase. Soft diffused afternoon light, interior design photography, eye level.

pendentes.alt: Sala de estar contemporânea ao entardecer com iluminação indireta no forro, persianas motorizadas meio abertas e um painel de controle discreto na parede
pendentes.pedido: A contemporary high-end living room at dusk with warm indirect LED lighting hidden in a plaster ceiling recess, motorized sheer shades half open over floor-to-ceiling windows, a low sofa in light bouclé fabric and a walnut coffee table. A small blank matte wall control panel near the doorway, a turned-off black television on a stone wall. Architectural interior photography, wide angle, eye level.

pendentes.alt: Detalhe de uma mesa de madeira maciça ao lado de um aparador de lâmina natural numa sala clara
pendentes.pedido: Interior design photography of a bright dining room corner. In the foreground, the thick edge of a solid oak dining table with visible end grain; behind it, a slim sideboard with a smooth walnut veneer finish and flush doors. Light linen curtains, a white plastered wall and a ceramic vase with dry branches. Soft natural daylight from a side window, close-up three-quarter angle with shallow depth of field.

pendentes.alt: Sala de estar aconchegante com lareira de pedra acesa, poltronas de couro e manta de lã
pendentes.pedido: Interior design photography of a cozy living room at dusk with a built-in fireplace clad in rough gray stone, a gentle wood fire glowing inside. Two leather lounge chairs, a chunky wool throw and a low walnut coffee table. Large window showing blue evening light and trees outside. Warm ambient lighting, eye-level wide shot.

pendentes.alt: Sala vazia de apartamento com piso de madeira e feixes de sol entrando por uma janela ampla
pendentes.pedido: Architectural photography of an empty bright living room in a residential apartment, light oak wooden floor and white walls, a wide window with thin black aluminum frames letting in long beams of morning sunlight that draw soft rectangles on the floor. A single potted olive tree near the window. Calm, airy atmosphere, eye-level wide-angle shot.

pendentes.alt: Banheiro claro com piso de porcelanato amadeirado, bancada de pedra clara, toalhas de linho dobradas e luz suave de inverno pela janela
pendentes.pedido: A serene modern bathroom on a cool winter morning, with large-format warm wood-look porcelain floor tiles and a light stone vanity. Folded beige linen towels on a wooden stool, a small potted fern and a frosted window letting in soft diffused daylight. Calm, cozy atmosphere, interior design photography, eye level, natural light.

pendentes.alt: Sala com parede pintada em verde-sálvia suave, sofá de linho cru, aparador de madeira e luz natural entrando por uma janela lateral
pendentes.pedido: A calm living room with one wall painted in a soft muted sage green and the other walls in warm off-white. A low sofa in natural linen, a light oak sideboard with a ceramic vase and a jute rug on a wooden floor. Soft late-afternoon daylight entering from a side window, interior design photography, eye level, gentle shadows.
